# Jacob Chademwiri

> Tender Manager (Primary) | Project Delivery & ISO 9001/14001/45001 Implementation Lead | SAP & Sage Contract Billing (AR) Manager | Complementary Web & Bid-Tech Developer based in Centurion, Gauteng, South Africa.

## Core Identity & Positioning
- **Primary Role (Employment & Executive Leadership)**: Tender Manager who doesn't stop at the bid box—winning municipal and corporate contracts (5+ awarded 3-year City of Tshwane tenders across 40+ plant, water, sanitation, and horticulture categories), leading the ISO 9001, 14001 & 45001 compliance systems that qualify bids, coordinating awarded project delivery as needed, and governing contract billing and accounts receivable in SAP ERP and Sage Accounting.
- **Compliance & Operational Backbone**: Appointed Management Representative directing Integrated Management Systems (ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015, ISO 45001:2018 under Annex SL) and Driven Machinery Regulations (DMR 19) compliance for Lifting Machinery Entity (LME) and fleet operations.
- **Complementary Technical Edge & Consulting**: Founder of Playhouse Media Group, creator of TenderTrack360 (bid-management SaaS), and developer of high-performance contractor websites in Astro, Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS—plus select freelance tender preparation and ISO compliance consulting.
